_comment: Manual touch-ups for the routing result of 2026-11-15 (run build/bx8, 0.15 mm signal rules).
They belong to that Freerouting result: after a new autorouter run look at the open connections again.
Coordinates are board coordinates in mm (CAD/board_interface.json).
1. U1 pin 3 (BTN_6) was sealed in by the +3V3 via of pin 4 / C72 at 56.75/30.74 and by BTN_5: the via
is removed (pin 4 stays connected to C72 by its track, the touch-up router links +3V3 again) and
BTN_6 gets a via right below its pad.
2. U2 pin 26 (USBESP_D_P) was sealed in by the UART track of pin 27: U0RXD is released and routed
again after D_P has its via.

2. U2 pin 26 (USBESP_D_P) was sealed in by the UART track of pin 27: U0RXD is released; both pins get
a hand-placed exit with a via (D_P at 17.6/26.1, U0RXD at 16.9/26.45) and are routed on from there.
3. U8 pin 3 (USBESP_D_P) leaves between the tracks of pins 2 and 4, 0.15 mm wide for 1.4 mm, to a via
